summaries.senior-go-cd: Senior Backend Engineer (Go), Continuous Delivery with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Go, distributed systems, continuous-delivery/release orchestration, and policy-based governance for enterprise platforms. Owned release engineering end-to-end for four open-source Go CLIs at Turbot HQ (9,300+ GitHub stars, 120+ merged PRs), unifying GitHub Actions release workflows and cutting Azure resource-discovery latency 70-90% through AI-assisted automation.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Owned release engineering end-to-end for four open-source Go CLIs (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — unified GitHub Actions continuous-delivery workflows, automated Slack release notifications, and GHCR Docker image tagging.

Built GitHub-as-a-cloud governance controls extending Guardrails with rule builders, a scoring engine, and policy-based prevention rules for branch protection, workflow permissions, runner access, dependency restrictions, MFA, and commit-author rules — enterprise-grade governance for distributed engineering teams.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and PR creation as part of a daily AI-powered engineering workflow; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal distributed microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven distributed pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for reliable failure handling and reprocessing.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
Mentored teammates on adopting AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code, Cursor) into their daily workflows.
